research_question: Can typed multi-signal routing with explicit unknown handling, hierarchical authorized filtering, and route/boundary-specific decision thresholds raise natural supported exact-route accuracy while materially improving unsupported-operation rejection?
architectural_principles: Trusted schema graph remains the only source of executable route authority.
Caller, policy, health, and deterministic schema constraints filter the candidate universe before semantic ranking.
Tool-domain, operation-action, field/concept, qualifier, negative-capability, and pairwise evidence are distinct score kinds.
Missing or failed evidence is unknown, never an invented numeric zero.
Raw scores from incompatible score kinds are not averaged or directly compared.
Semantic components may rank, filter, veto, or abstain only over already-authorized routes.
Prefer no-route/abstention to an executable false route.
No benchmark-specific alias or unsupported keyword may be added from observed development failures.

dev_holdout.use: one-shot development confirmation; no threshold retuning after reveal

requirements: normalized exact overlap with all checked-in prior/dev/calibration corpora = 0
corpus leakage audit before model scoring
supported and unsupported semantic families must be identified explicitly
tune and dev_holdout must not share semantic family IDs
language and route/domain balance must be deterministic

first_ablation.rationale: Aurelio Semantic Router implements per-route thresholds and LiteLLM capability routing maps different capability boundaries to different thresholds. Fresh 0.10 calibration showed one global operation boundary was insufficient for natural unsupported families.
implementation: stable tool.endpoint option IDs in operation-fit requests
first_ablation.fitting_rule: Estimate route-local thresholds on tune only. Freeze the threshold map before reading dev_holdout results.
first_ablation.holdout_rule: Evaluate the frozen threshold map exactly once on dev_holdout. If it misses any preregistered gate, reject the threshold-map candidate and do not retune from holdout.
